description: This file defines test hooks, function pointer types, data structures, and function prototypes for a testing framework related to hardware simulation in Zephyr OS, including test lifecycle callbacks, test list management, and fake hardware device interfaces.

methods.name: bst_add_tests
methods.description: Adds test instances to the test list.

methods.name: bst_set_testapp_mode
methods.description: Sets the test application mode based on test ID.

methods.name: bst_pass_args
methods.description: Passes command line arguments to the test framework.

methods.name: bst_main
methods.description: Main entry point for test execution.

methods.name: bst_delete
methods.description: Cleans up and deletes test resources.

methods.name: bst_print_testslist
methods.description: Prints the list of registered tests.

methods.name: bst_ticker_set_period
methods.description: Sets the period for the fake hardware timer.

methods.name: bst_ticker_set_next_tick_absolute
methods.description: Schedules the next timer tick at an absolute time.

methods.name: bst_ticker_set_next_tick_delta
methods.description: Schedules the next timer tick after a delta.

methods.name: bst_awake_cpu_asap
methods.description: Wakes up the CPU as soon as possible.
